panel.introduction: 9P/Tempel 1 was visited by Deep Impact in 2005 and Stardust-NExT in 2011. Their images constrain the published nucleus model. Gray marks stereo control, blue limb silhouettes, and ochre poorly constrained regions of the published shape.

facts.label: Stereo coverage
facts.value: 480 stereo control points on about 70% of the nucleus

moreFacts.label: Presentation
moreFacts.value: Published PDS shape model, including poorly constrained source estimates. The constraint lens uses gray for stereo control, blue for limb silhouettes, and ochre for poorly constrained terrain. These are evidence categories, not surface colors. The combined model pole is retained at RA 255°, Dec +64.5°. Rotational phase is arbitrary and held fixed; no encounter or current rotation reconstruction is claimed.
